item.description:
BalanceEQ 1.2.1

Neutral now refits the published headphone measurement toward its compatible open reference, improving predicted accuracy without adding bands or playback buffering. Reapply Neutral to use the new fit. Existing presets and Harman keep their sound.

Harman uses the full headphone-specific correction, not only a bass shelf. Both modes remain model-based predictions, not measurements of your individual pair or guarantees of acoustic flatness.

This community build is ad-hoc signed and unnotarized. Updates preserve presets and stop EQ during restart. Choose Start EQ afterward; macOS may request audio permission again.
